_comment: District 11 (GDD §4.1 chain order), CHAIN TERMINAL and ACT III FINALE (GDD §12.3: D9-11). data/districts/district_power_station.tres powered_by = [&"substation"] — GDD §4.3 requires the prerequisite at FULL, so the guaranteed closure is substation's seven-district closure PLUS substation itself: suburbs, residential, park, hospital, warehouses, police, industrial, substation (eight districts, all stages). NOT guaranteed: school, gas_station (leaves; no id is gated on them). This is the first and only district where radio_03_keeper_reversal (power_station / min_stage 1) is legal. Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): destroyer, destroyer, watcher — DOUBLE DESTROYER, the heaviest lead in the chain: both have no light reaction at all AND break nearby streetlights on patrol (destroyer_3d.gd), so light here is less than a consumable — it is bait (R5). The watcher holds the corridor (2 s beam-stun, then rage x1.25 / 5 s, breath 5 m, 15 m scream pulls BOTH destroyers). Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): fuse, transistor, medkit — the finale pays out chain parts plus mercy (medicine), mirrored in the tables and power_station_fix_med_01. Story doc canon: doc_core_station ('800 MW, DO NOT START AFTER 23:00, generators no longer produce current — they produce voices') — extended, never copied, by power_station_note_04 (the pencil line's author). Blueprint CANON: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS has NO power_station row — exactly four blueprint districts (residential/park/police/warehouses); GDD §9 lists no D11 craft — R7. Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd reactor_power_station (CODE's zone — this pack cites the id and its zone only, never the reward or mechanics). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Drum cable on the reactor-room spool rack, open from the west corridor; feeder cable is what this building is.
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. The operations wall cabinet — rack fuses under the duty board that kept the 23:00 order (power_station_note_04).

Guarantee: transistor for FULL. The archive's solid-state spares, racked beside the memorandum file ('I will answer for the current to the unit' — power_station_note_05). Archive locked; opened by power_station_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).

Archive key in the operations desk drawer, unlocked — the night engineer's drawer, same discipline as the substation control desk and the industrial foreman's desk. Reachable in DARK with zero tools (R1).
Battery top-up on arrival; the gate is the district's safe pocket at the end of the last road, and the hall beyond it is double-destroyer ground in fog.

Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT: medkit): the crew's center-camp first-aid locker, left stocked — Marat's standing order to the end of the line (power_station_note_07). The finale pays mercy, non-RNG by R6.
Finale mercy cache: gate-crate dressings staged for the walk back up the line (FULL only). Nobody walks back down it — the road behind is done.
Optional risk-reward salvage: a spare transformer unit in the hall parts bin — deliberately inside destroyer A's patrol (R5), never chain-critical, never required by any rule.
Optional risk-reward salvage: yard offcuts in the frost drum — deliberately inside destroyer B's patrol (R5), never chain-critical, never required by any rule.

Fixed defense cache: the gate compressed-air horn test canisters (noise_bomb, STREETS+ — R2). Fire discipline keeps them out of the reactor room, the archive and the bunker (R8); the hall is oil and paper.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor): cable on the reactor-room spool, fuse in the operations cabinet, transistor in the archive rack; the archive key (power_station_fix_key_01) sits in operations' unlocked desk drawer, so the whole chain is reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot. None of the three chain components or the key sits in either destroyer's patrol (turbine hall / cooling yard + towers edge) — a player who never fights them still finishes.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. fuse and transistor never roll in DARK (the operations cabinet and the archive rack are the DARK sources); molotov enters rolls at PARTIAL, noise_bomb at STREETS — mirroring the substation/industrial discipline.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.

R4: No firearms in power_station. There is no pistol/rifle/ammo id in data/items. molotov/noise_bomb remain the combat ceiling; the district pays out chain parts plus mercy (fuse/transistor/medkit per BY_DISTRICT) and lets the reactor_power_station puzzle pay whatever CODE's zone decides (this pack cites the puzzle id and its zone only — never the reward or mechanics).

R5: DOUBLE-DESTROYER FINALE (enemy_pool.gd [destroyer, destroyer, watcher]) — the heaviest lead in the chain: BOTH destroyers have NO light reaction and BREAK nearby streetlights while patrolling (destroyer_3d.gd), so light here is less than a consumable — it is bait that marks where you have been; their cues are the twin machinery hums audible at 12 m and their weakness is the 5 m / 180-degree sight — cover is generator-block spacing, not beams. The watcher holds the ops/archive corridor: 2 s beam-stun, then rage x1.25 for 5 s, breath audible at 5 m, and its 15 m scream pulls BOTH destroyers at once — the corridor is the most dangerous room in the district precisely because it looks safe. The DARK chain (R1) never requires light, combat or a chase.

R6: Scripted caches must not roll empty: the reactor spool, the fuse cabinet, the operations desk, the archive rack, the camp locker and the gate crates are fixed payouts (mirrors substation spool/cabinet/desk/rack/locker/crate).

R7: No blueprint in power_station: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon is exactly four districts (residential, park, police, warehouses) — power_station is not one of them, and GDD §9 lists no D11 craft (same class as substation's D10). No schematic id may roll or fix-spawn here.

R8: z_archive never relights at any stage (windowless and locked; read by corridor spill — mirrors substation's vault, industrial's switchgear): no streetlight_3d inside, global relight passes must skip it. z_bunker never relights at any stage (deep, unwired; read by hand-lamp spill only — the racks are examined, never lit). Fire discipline: no molotov/noise_bomb cache inside z_reactor_room, z_archive or z_bunker — the hall is oil and the archive is paper; the district's memory burns once. The district's fixed defense cache is the gate air-horn canister.
